inputs.tags: Instrumental hard-rock episode intro, ~30 seconds, high energy, fast tempo locked near 140 BPM. Core band identity stays pure hard rock: dual electric guitars (tight rhythm crunch plus lead stabs and power-chord hits), locked-in electric bass with aggressive pick attack, live drum kit (snare cracks, fast kick pattern, crash/ride accents), punchy brass hits for lift, extra rock percussion, and steel-string acoustic guitar for rhythmic drive and midrange texture. Andean color is flare only—never the lead: brief charango plucks, cajón body hits, short quena and zampoña (siku) phrases, and sparse bombo thumps used as occasional texture on top of the rock bed; keep these elements light, secondary, and sparse so the track remains unmistakably hard rock with a light Peruvian accent. Structure: atmospheric fade-in bed of sustained guitar noise, soft cymbal swell, and distant low percussion for the first ~8 seconds, then full-band kick-in with drums, bass, and distorted guitars slamming in together; maintain relentless high energy through the body with brass punches and quick Andean texture flashes; end on a clean controlled fade-out. No vocals, no lyrics, no choir, no sung or spoken elements—pure instrumental cue suitable as a 30-second high-energy show open.
